_comment: Licence policy for a PROPRIETARY product. Anything not allowed, denied or covered by an unexpired exception fails the build. Evaluated over package-lock.json (production and development, direct and transitive).

exceptions.reason: Optional prebuilt native libvips binaries pulled in by Next.js image optimisation. The application does not use next/image, they are dynamically linked native libraries (not statically combined with our code) and are never modified. Not part of the deployed output: CI check .github/scripts/check-shipped-artifact.mjs fails if sharp/libvips appear in what is shipped. Needs legal sign-off before shipping node_modules, enabling next/image or distributing the build for self-hosting. See docs/security/EXCEPTIONS.md EX-02.

Browser-support data licensed CC-BY-4.0 (attribution). Data only, not executable code. Build-time only, not in the shipped output (same CI check). Attribution is in THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md, generated and checked in CI. See docs/security/EXCEPTIONS.md EX-03.

_scope: Applies to the PRODUCT (front-end/package-lock.json) only. The deploy tooling in .github/vercel-cli is build-time tooling that is never distributed.
